# EZHD

> EZHD is a two-person marketing studio in St. George, Utah. We build websites, shoot and post real photo and video content, and manage Google Business Profiles, local SEO and paid ads for Southern Utah businesses. One team and one invoice instead of separate vendors. Pricing is quoted per project on a 20-minute call.

Contact: ezhdco@gmail.com · (435) 224-6987 · https://ez-hd.co/#contact
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ezhd_co/
Service area: St. George and Washington County (Washington, Hurricane, Ivins, Santa Clara, La Verkin), Cedar City, and across Utah.

## Services

- [Build: website, care plan and local SEO](https://ez-hd.co/services/build/): custom sites live in one to two weeks, hosted and maintained, plus Google Business Profile work.
- [Create: content and social media](https://ez-hd.co/services/create/): on-site photo and video, edited, captioned and published to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and Google.
- [Grow: paid ads and brand](https://ez-hd.co/services/grow/): Google and Meta campaigns against a budget the client sets, plus logo and print design.
- [Web design](https://ez-hd.co/services/web-design/)
- [Website hosting and care](https://ez-hd.co/services/website-hosting/)
- [Local SEO and Google Business Profile](https://ez-hd.co/services/local-seo/)
- [Social media management](https://ez-hd.co/services/social-media-management/)
- [Paid advertising](https://ez-hd.co/services/paid-advertising/)
- [Brand and design](https://ez-hd.co/services/brand-design/)
- [All twelve services, hired one at a time](https://ez-hd.co/services/)
